properties.name: Amirani — Georgian Prometheus
properties.summary: Amirani, son of a goddess, stole fire from the heavens and gave it to humanity. As punishment, he was chained to a rock in the Caucasus Mountains where an eagle eternally pecks at his heart. He still struggles to break free, causing earthquakes. The parallel with Prometheus is striking and ancient.

properties.name: The Golden Fleece in Colchis
properties.summary: In Georgian tradition, King Aeetes of Colchis guarded the Golden Fleece — the skin of a divine ram that had rescued children from sacrifice. The fleece hung in a sacred grove guarded by a dragon. When Jason came with the Argonauts, Aeetes' daughter Medea betrayed her father out of love. The story reflects Colchis's historical gold wealth.
